technical_and_design_decisions: Implementation will be in Go, extending the existing Hyperledger Fabric configuration library (e.g., configtx / config library).
API design will follow existing library patterns, using strongly typed Go structs and standard error handling routines.
Capability manipulation functions (U5) will support both explicit helper functions/toggles and standard capability setters/deleters to allow managing unknown or custom capabilities cleanly.
Examples will be implemented as Go executable example tests (`Example...` functions) ensuring they act as both runnable documentation and automated tests.
assumptions: The core protobuf data structures and basic config update generation mechanisms (`configtx.Compute`) already exist in the codebase.
No external network dependencies are required for unit and example tests; mock or sample protobuf config blocks can be generated in memory.
All work is carried out by a single software engineer familiar with Go and Hyperledger Fabric channel configuration structures.

activities.activity_description: Set up the local development environment, analyze existing configuration parser/builder structures, and plan function signatures for missing helper functions.
Implement functions to add and remove orderer endpoints from an orderer organization's configuration group, including standard validation and protobuf updates, with unit tests.
Implement a helper function to inspect and retrieve policies for a specified organization (Application, Orderer, or Consortium), along with unit tests.

activities.activity_name: Capabilities Inspection and Modification API (U4, U5)
activities.activity_description: Implement capability retrieval functions for orderer, application, and channel capabilities returning `config.Capabilities`, and implement functions/toggles to add and remove capabilities, along with unit tests.

activities.activity_name: Application Config Retrieval & ACL Updates (U6, U7)
activities.activity_description: Implement functions to retrieve existing application configuration (`config.Application`) and to add/remove ACLs from an application group, along with unit tests.

activities.activity_name: Example Test Suite Refactoring & Modularization (U8 & Examples)
activities.activity_description: Refactor the giant end-to-end example into smaller, focused example tests demonstrating orderer updates, application updates, organization management, MSP modifications, and capability changes.
Perform full test suite execution, verify all acceptance criteria across U1-U8, refine code documentation, and prepare the pull request.
